fact_check_log.claim: Intro and takeaway 1: five areas (Agios Ioannis/Ornos, Psarou/Platis Gialos, Elia, Agios Sostis, hilltop above Paradise beach); four venues on the west coast
fact_check_log.fact_id: fact_21, fact_04, fact_11, fact_400, fact_106, fact_109, fact_111, fact_207, fact_205, fact_405

fact_check_log.claim: 'Closest to Mykonos Town' (intro, takeaway 1, west coast para) and 'quieter/busier' north vs south
Takeaway 2: capacity from 25 (Mykonos Grand chapel) to 800 (Saint John); Katikies Private Balcony seats 20, so reworded as a range
Takeaway 3: Lolita religious, civil and symbolic; Mykonos Grand religious only if both partners Christian Orthodox
Takeaway 4 and When to marry: heatwaves frequent in summer, little shade; wildfires June to September; swimming care

Santa Marina: private peninsula at southern tip of Ornos Bay, minutes from town, 40 years, chapel, sea-view venues, planners, elopement parties, 2026 brochure and menus, Elais, private dining, Ginkgo Spa; capacity/rooms/exclusive use not published
Katikies Mykonos: five-star, above Agios Ioannis, ~4 km/10 min, sea views to Delos, children above 13, Upper deck 50/100 marked for ceremonies, other spaces 50 and 20, micro weddings
Katikies hotel take-over: group-level wording only; table cell reworded to 'not published for this hotel'

Mykonos Grand: five-star beachfront, opposite Delos, Cycladic charm, private beach section, Virgin Mary chapel on hill, 25 inside/100 outdoors, Orthodox rule, amphitheatre, evening shuttle, rooms/suites/villa, liaises with planner
Mykonos Grand closing line 'If neither of you is Christian Orthodox': wrong condition (rule needs both)

Saint John: Agios Ioannis sunset spot, Agia Fotini Chapel/sunset balcony/deck, four reception spaces (Ilios, Thalatta indoor), sea views, up to 800 guests, welcome cocktails to five-course dinners, works with planners at additional charge
Mykonos Blu: weddings and vow renewals on Psarou, sunset backdrop, specialists, menus, Cycladic settlement, 103 rooms, Ocean Balcony 60, L'Archipel 120, BLU cave pool, ceremony type not stated
Petasos: private peninsula between Platis Gialos and Psarou, La Petite Psarou, Cycladic design quote, capacities by space, Amphitheatre no capacity, saltwater pool, 500 sq m spa, no ceremony venue
Myconian Ambassador: above Platis Gialos, 5 km, Psarou walkable, small chapel then beach or deck, grand banquets recommended to Elia, Efisia, 'experts in romance and discretion'
Myconian Ambassador described as 'a small hotel for intimate weddings'

Myconian Collection Elia: Elia named as wedding hotels, one team, Royal/Imperial details, chapel, all denominations, Horizons Ballroom 270/380-400/550, semi-open, four sections, halal/kosher, South Asian chef, own planner or full solution, fireworks
'Royal Myconian and Myconian Imperial are the two with their own weddings pages' (research talk; Villa Collection also has one)

Grecotel Mykonos Lolita: little hotel on secluded private beach after Agios Sostis, off the beaten path, chapel with religious/civil/symbolic, Cycladic setting quote, near Agios Sostis and Panormos, path to beach, six room types and Villa Thea, Veranda, infinity pool with hydro massage, no capacity
Lolita civil chapel wedding 'matters if you want the legal ceremony' (implied legal validity)

ZeNIT: hilltop above Paradise beach, Aegean and Delos, no rooms, pool terrace/two terraces/central hall, traditional-style wedding, capacity by layout, 20 m pool, two bars, open kitchen, all-weather hall, physician, CCTV, own transfers up to 16
ZeNIT partner and sea transfers
Island of the winds, heart of the Cyclades; JMK; flights 45 min from Athens, 1 h 10 from Thessaloniki
Airport bus to Chora from stop in front of terminal (Arrivals), tickets from driver; taxi stand outside Arrivals

Legal: CNI questions, DFAT, embassy/consulate; Athens Embassy notarial services, appointments, post, two working days, no legal advice, fees apply; overseas marriage recognition and name-change caveat
FAQ 'Can Australians legally get married': unsupported 'Yes' replaced by legal-steps lead
Indoor or covered fallback at Saint John, Myconian Collection, ZeNIT
Closing Advisor paragraph: one person, time zone, AUD quotes, plans venue/travel/vendors/payments anywhere, fee agreed in writing, inclusions confirmed in writing
Body Advisor line 'confirms in writing with the venue' curfew/minimum nights (beyond brand facts)
